switch.title: Switch to {{branch}}?
switch.body: You have uncommitted changes. What should happen to them?
switch.leaveHint: They're set aside and offered back when you return to {{branch}}.
switch.bringHint: Git refuses if they clash with files on the other branch.

create.title: Create a branch
create.name: Name
create.from: Starts from {{branch}}. Your uncommitted changes come along.
create.fromCommit: Starts from commit {{hash}} ({{summary}}). Uncommitted changes come along too.

delete.title: Delete {{branch}}?
delete.body: The branch is deleted from this computer. Commits that are on other branches stay.
delete.unmergedBody: These commits aren't on any other branch. Deleting the branch may lose them.

merge.title: Merge into {{branch}}
merge.choose: Choose a branch to merge into {{branch}}.
merge.preview_one: This will bring {{count}} commit from {{from}} into {{into}}.
merge.preview_other: This will bring {{count}} commits from {{from}} into {{into}}.

stash.banner: You left changes on this branch earlier.
stash.discardBody: The changes you left on {{branch}} will be removed from the stash list. Right after, you can undo it from the notice.

conflicts.unknown: Conflicts can't be predicted (git 2.38 or later shows them).

base.conflicts_one: Bringing it in now conflicts in {{count}} file. Conflicts grow the longer branches stay apart, so bring it in early.
base.conflicts_other: Bringing it in now conflicts in {{count}} files. Conflicts grow the longer branches stay apart, so bring it in early.
base.far: Nothing conflicts yet, but conflicts grow the longer branches stay apart. Bringing it in now keeps it easy.
base.title: Bring In {{base}}

modeHints.merge: Makes a merge commit joining both histories. Your commits stay as they are.
modeHints.rebase: Replays this branch's commits on top of the latest, for a straight history. Available because the branch isn't on the remote yet.

base.publishedMerges: A branch already pushed is brought up to date by merging. Rebasing it would need a force push and change the history others have.
base.autostash: Uncommitted changes are set aside and put back afterwards.

cleanup.title: Clean Up Branches
cleanup.intro: These branches are already in the default branch or were deleted on the remote. After deleting them you can still undo it from the notice.
cleanup.none: Nothing to clean up. Branches merged into the default branch or deleted on the remote show up here.
cleanup.unmerged_one: Has {{count}} commit the default branch doesn't. Deleting it may lose that commit.
cleanup.unmerged_other: Has {{count}} commits the default branch doesn't. Deleting it may lose those commits.
cleanup.unknownUnmerged: Without a known default branch, Garam couldn't check whether it was merged.
